name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – Before § 1 – Am 22
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: – 1. Expresses deep concern at the rising cost of living, in particular the increase in fuel and energy prices and the high prices of essential goods, as well as their significant impact on the lives of workers, pensioners and their families, in a context where the profits of large corporate groups continue to increase and, in several sectors, are reaching exceptionally high levels; considers that the European Union budget for 2027 should contribute to addressing this situation by protecting living standards and purchasing power and supporting measures aimed at curbing prices and mitigating the social and economic consequences of the rising cost of living;
